# One UI icon attribution

The One UI inspired media play and pause vector paths in `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_oneui_play.xml` and `ic_oneui_pause.xml` are adapted from [OneUIProject/oneui-icons](https://github.com/OneUIProject/oneui-icons), specifically `ic_oui_control_play.xml` and `ic_oui_control_pause.xml`.
